weapon.d: Inflicts Spd-5. If unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice.
Inflicts Spd-5. If unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice.

If unit is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+5 to unit during combat, and also, if foe initiates combat, reduces damage from foe's follow-up attack by 60% during combat ("follow-up attack" normally means only the second strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the third and fourth strikes).

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of damage dealt to unit.
Boosts damage by 50% of damage dealt to unit.

b.d:
If unit's HP ≥ 90%, foes cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit.
(Does not affect foes with Pass skills.)

If unit's HP ≥ 70%, foes cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit.
(Does not affect foes with Pass skills.)

If unit's HP ≥ 50%, foes cannot move through spaces adjacent to unit.
(Does not affect foes with Pass skills.)
